lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: the relationship between sine and cosine of complementary angles
lessonRef.title: Concept model C: the relationship between sine and cosine of complementary angles

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example is written more briefly. Fill in the reasoning it leaves out.

items.prompt: A 3-4-5 triangle, θ opposite the side 3. Find sin θ.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A right triangle has legs 9 and 12. Find the hypotenuse.
Express sin 32° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 148°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 122°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 32°, because sine and cosine are always equal
cos 58°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent

items.prompt: From a point 120 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 27 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A right triangle has legs 8 and 15 and hypotenuse 17. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 8. Find tan θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
A right triangle has legs 5 and 12. Find the hypotenuse.
Express sin 52° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 38°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent
cos 142°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 128°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 52°, because sine and cosine are always equal

items.prompt: From a point 21 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 20 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
choices: cos θ = 20/21
tan θ = 20/21
sin θ = 20/21
tan θ = 21/20

items.prompt: A right triangle has legs 10 and 24 and hypotenuse 26. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 10. Find sin θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

choices: cos 49°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent
cos 139°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 41°, because sine and cosine are always equal
cos 131°, because the angles differ by a right angle
